elseif($Action -eq 'stop'){& docker @trial stop db mailpit 2>&1|Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $reports 'stop.log')}

 $service='api'
 if($Action -like 'browser*' -or $Action -in @('browser','browser-regression','browser-b02','browser-final','browser-diagnostic','browser-us1','identity','browser-harness','discovery','browser-login','browser-profile')){$service='browser-tests'}

  '--volume',((Join-Path $state.Root 'apps/web/src')+':/workspace/apps/web/src:ro'),

  '--volume',((Join-Path $state.Root 'ops/lint')+':/workspace/ops/lint:ro'),
  '--volume',((Join-Path $auditRoot 't067-t068')+':/verification:ro'),$service)
 & docker @trial --profile tests @run node /verification/verify.mjs $Action 2>&1|Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $reports ($Action+'.log'))
}

exit $actualExit
